instruction: Please use VLC to extract the audio track from the video file on my desktop and save the result as an MP3 file. The output should be saved on the desktop with the filename "Baby Justin Bieber.mp3".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires audio extraction from video using VLC. Evaluator checks for file existence with minimum 200KB size to ensure quality audio extraction. Reference MP3 is 3.5MB, so 200KB ensures substantial content.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file existence at the specified path (/home/user/Desktop/Baby Justin Bieber.mp3)
Minimum size check (200KB) is reasonable heuristic to ensure substantial audio content was extracted (reference file is 3.5MB)
Getter logic correctly extracts file properties using bash stat command
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' (directly accesses expected.get('min_size'))
Logic will work correctly at runtime - no state timing issues as file persists after task completion
No postconfig needed as verification is file-based, not UI-dependent
